seed_note: CKKS encryption randomness comes from Microsoft SEAL's internal CSPRNG and is not seeded, so HE runs are not bit-reproducible; differences are at CKKS precision.

homomorphic_encryption.security_basis: Total coefficient modulus 200 bits <= 218 bits allowed for N=8192 at 128-bit classical security (HomomorphicEncryption.org standard, enforced by Microsoft SEAL)
homomorphic_encryption.encrypted_entries: All floating-point state entries (weights, biases, BatchNorm affine and running statistics); integer BatchNorm counters stay plaintext (public function of sample counts)
homomorphic_encryption.server_operations: plaintext-scalar multiplication by public weight n_k / sum n, then ciphertext addition; no secret key on the server
homomorphic_encryption.key_model: Clients share one CKKS secret key (simulated key holders); the server holds the public context only
